title: The periodic tensor calculation for a square-zero exact divisor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $t\in R$ satisfy $t^2=0$ and $\{r\in R:tr=0\}=tR$. Put $F=R/tR$. The augmented sequence $\cdots\xrightarrow{t}R\xrightarrow{t}R\to F\to0$ is a free resolution, and for every $q\geq0$ one has $H^{-q}(F\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F)\cong F$, equivalently $\operatorname{Tor}^R_q(F,F)\cong F$. Here derived tensor is computed from K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex] in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every scheme $V$, let $R_V,F_V$ denote constant sheaves on $V_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then $H^{-q}(F_V\otimes_{R_V}^{\mathbf L}F_V)\cong F_V$ for every $q\geq0$, with derived tensor as in [def-weil-derived-tensor]. If $F\ne0$ and $V$ is nonempty, all these sheaves are nonzero.
